AUBO Robot skill v1.0.0 – initial release.

- Created a Python-based control skill for AUBO collaborative robots (iS3/iS5/iS7/iS10/iS12/iS16) via RTDE over TCP.
- Supports connection and motion control in ARCS simulation VM using VMware.
- Implements key movement commands: joint, linear, and circular motions; real-time state feedback; global speed tuning; and stop functions.
- Provides API wrappers for control and state queries, with IO operation examples.
- Ready for integration with the OpenClaw framework; full simulation environment setup instructions included.
